"''Ghouls!|The stormtrooper talking to their colleague|}} A [[human]] served as one of the [[First Order]]'s '''stormtroopers''' assigned to [[Ben Solo|Kylo Ren's]] [[flagship]] the [[Steadfast (Resurgent-class)|''Steadfast'']].''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' As Ren and his Knights strode through the ''Steadfast''{{'s}} corridors into the conference room, the [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] noticed the group and made a comment to their fellow guard about the [[Knights of Ren]], prompting their colleague to turn toward them and remark "ghouls!" ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Here's the process. I had the good fortune to go and visit J.J. Abrams while he was shooting ''The Rise of Skywalker''. While I was there, he put me in a stormtrooper uniform and we had a really fun day on set. It's been one of my life-long goals to be a stormtrooper, so I can tick that off now.|Karl Urban|{{WebCite|url=https://www.digitalspy.com/movies/a33444596/karl-urban-star-wars-rise-of-skywalker-cameo|text=The Boys and Star Trek star reveals secret Rise of Skywalker cameo|author=Susannah Alexander and Adam Tanswell|date=2020-07-18|quote=Confirming that the Karl Urban listed in the 'additional voices' section of the end credits of the 2019 film is indeed him, the actor explained how his cameo came about. "Here's the process," he said. "I had the good fortune to go and visit JJ Abrams [the film's director] while he was shooting ''The Rise of Skywalker''. While I was there, he put me in a stormtrooper uniform and we had a really fun day on set. "It's been one of my life-long goals to be a stormtrooper, so I can tick that off now." He also pinpointed the moment in which he is seen (or rather, his stormtrooper costume is) and heard, which is during a scene set on Kylo Ren's (Adam Driver) spaceship. "What is in the cut is my voice saying 'Knights of Ren' as Kylo Ren walks down a hallway past two stormtroopers. I am one of those stormtroopers," he said.|archiveurl=https://archive.is/ajaFH}}}} The stormtrooper was portrayed by [[Karl Urban]] in the [[2019]] film [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']], although in the movie credits, the actor is merely listed as providing "additional voices". According to Urban, he visited director [[J.J. Abrams]] while the latter was shooting the film and Abrams put him in a [[Stormtrooper armor|stormtrooper uniform]], resulting in what the actor referred to as "a really fun day on set" for both of them. In [[2013]], when asked if he would appear in ''Star Wars'', Urban stated that he would never do a ''Star Wars'' movie because he was recognizable from ''[[Wikipedia:Star Trek|Star Trek]]'' and he felt that seeing a ''Star Trek'' actor in a ''Star Wars'' movie would be a big turn-off for the audience.{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2013/08/03/star-treks-bones-karl-urban-on-why-he-would-never-do-a-star-wars-movie-and-hopes-for-an-original-story-for-star-trek-3|text=Star Trek's Bones, Karl Urban, on Why He Would Never Do a Star Wars Movie And Hopes For An Original Story For Star Trek 3|author=Cornet, Ruth|date=2013-08-03|quote=During the course of our conversation we asked the actor if, given the close nature of his relationship with Abrams, he'd lobbied to be a part of Star Wars: Episode VII and he replied immediately, "No, absolutely not." Somewhat taken aback by the total clarity of his denial, we asked if he was a fan of the Star Wars franchise. "Oh my God, yes," Urban replied immediately. "I grew up watching it. That was the Holy Grail for me. I was a fan of Star Trek growing up. Star Wars was it. Star Wars was like…I remember waiting for two/three years for that next installment, for Empire Strikes Back and Return of the Jedi. I've seen every single Star Wars film, even the animated, The Clone Wars, and all that sort of stuff. I just love that universe, but that being said, I have no desire to be part of it. I don't see the worlds of Star Trek and Star Wars joining. I've made a commitment to Star Trek and I'm going to keep it. It wouldn't feel right to me. Being in Star Trek, to suddenly be in Star Wars wouldn't feel right to me." When we pointed out that Star Trek and Star Wars have been joined to some degree now that Abrams is set to helm Star Wars: Episode VII, Urban replied, "J.J. is behind the camera. There's a difference when you're putting a face and a personality in front of the camera, and I wouldn't want to do that do an audience. I, as an audience member, wouldn't want to see an actor from Star Trek in Star Wars. I just wouldn't. When I go into a Star Wars movie I want to be completely enveloped. I don't want to be taken out of the picture by going, 'Oh my God, there's Scotty, what's he doing in Star Wars?'"|archiveurl=https://archive.is/Fz7im}} However, in [[2018]], he stated that if he was given the opportunity, he would be glad to be part of it, commenting on the way fellow ''Star Trek'' actor [[Simon Pegg]] was completely unrecognizable in ''[[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|The Force Awakens]]'' and that there were ways and means to make a ''Star Wars'' appearance happen.{{WebCite|url=https://lrmonline.com/news/star-treks-karl-urban-would-love-to-join-a-star-wars-movie|text=Star Trek's Karl Urban Would Love To Join A Star Wars Movie|author=Medina, Joseph Jammer|date=2018-03-06|quote=''"Hell, yeah! I would consider it for sure. If I was blessed with that opportunity—I would glad to be a part of it. I've said it in the past that I would never do Star Wars, because I'm so recognizable as Leonard McCoy. Now Simon Pegg was in Star Wars: The Force Awakens. There are ways and means to make this happen obviously. [Laughs]"''|archiveurl=https://archive.is/BGqQQ}} ==Appearances== *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *[[Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Scroll_box|content={{Reflist}}}} [[Category:First Order stormtroopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
